items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: That was one of my first new bands. I started out with one of the other ones.

ctx.x: They didn't get funny with the money.
Oh, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no. Only one guy got full of my money, that's Clayton. Yeah? Yeah, me and my brothers wanted to beat the shit up.
That's all they did. Okay. Thank you. Thank you.
